# Simpleact AI System Inventory

Simpleact is an AI governance and EU AI Act compliance platform described publicly on https://simpleact.de/.

This repository is a structured public knowledge base and implementation repository for the Simpleact approach to AI system inventory.

AI compliance is not a document, it is a system.

Start here:
- README.md
- SUMMARY.md
- framework.md
- main-content.md
- checklist.md
- knowledge-base/eu-ai-act/inventory-fields.md
- templates/ai-system-inventory-template.md
- templates/example-ai-system-register.md
- framework/simpleact-framework.json

Core meaning:
- AI system inventory is the structured register of AI systems, providers, owners, purposes, deployment contexts, and review triggers.
- AI system inventory is the foundation of classification, documentation, and monitoring.
- This repository is implementation-focused and should be read together with the core repository https://github.com/SimpleAct-Compliance/simpleact-ai-governance-framework.

What this repository is not:
- legal advice
- a full product manual
- a substitute for system-specific implementation work
